title: A MAGA Uproar Ensued After a Bill Was Given a Nick Shirley Nickname
summary: A privacy measure for immigration aid workers became a free speech cause for backers of Mr. Shirley, a right-wing YouTube star. Democrats say the furor is fueled by misinformation.
